questions.passage: Ironically, years later, he seems to be happier with his decision than I. This may sound like the makings of a Chinese proverb, but it illustrates a larger truth: psychological research shows that trying to make others happy will make you happy, while trying to make yourself happy sometimes fails to do so. Indeed, psychologists have found that prosocial spending, writing gratitude letters, and having a satisficer (i.e., happy with good enough) mindset all promote happiness.
questions.prompt: Which paraphrase best matches the passage’s comparison of happiness-seeking strategies?
options: Self-focused efforts bring happiness more reliably than helping others.
Helping others brings happiness through the gratitude they return.
The approaches listed promote happiness through financial generosity.
Helping others can bring happiness; self-focused efforts may fail.
questions.promptZh: 哪一改写最符合本段对追求幸福方式的比较？
optionsZh: 专注自身的努力比帮助他人更可靠地带来幸福。
帮助他人通过对方回报的感激带来幸福。
所列方法都通过金钱上的慷慨促进幸福。
帮助他人可以带来幸福，而专注自身的努力有时会失败。
analyses: A 把原文对两种追求方式的对比倒置。原文强调努力使自己幸福有时并不奏效，没有说这种方式更可靠。
B 原文没有把对方回报的感激设为起作用的机制。writing gratitude letters 是写信表达自己的感激，不能换成收到他人的感激。
C 清单还包含写感恩信和满意即可的心态，不能把共同机制归结为花钱。
D 对应 make others happy will make you happy 与 make yourself happy sometimes fails；保留他人导向的益处和自我导向可能失败的区别。

evidence.quote: psychological research shows that trying to make others happy will make you happy, while trying to make yourself happy sometimes fails to do so.

vocabulary.meaning: 知足者；接受足够好结果的人
vocabulary.context: 作者用 happy with good enough 解释这种心态
vocabulary.example: A satisficer may choose a suitable option without comparing every alternative.
collocations: a satisficer rather than a maximizer

questions.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，多年后，父亲似乎比我更满意自己的决定。这听起来像是中国谚语的素材，却说明了一个更普遍的道理：心理学研究显示，努力让别人幸福也会使自己幸福，而努力让自己幸福有时反而做不到。的确，心理学家发现，亲社会支出、写感恩信，以及知足者心态，也就是对足够好的结果感到满意，都能促进幸福。
questions.editorialStatus: 按第 1 章 PDF 第 9–16 页具体原文编写；保持已发布短段边界；区分叙事、研究概括、比喻与引文

questions.passage: A psychologically rich life is a life filled with diverse, unusual, interesting experiences that change your perspective; a life with twists and turns; a dramatic, eventful life instead of a simple and straightforward one; a life with multiplicity and complexity; a life with lots of stops, detours, and turning points; a life that feels like a long, winding hike rather than many laps of the same racing circuit.
questions.prompt: Which feature is central to the author’s definition of a psychologically rich life?
options: Varied experiences that change one's perspective.
Personal contentment maintained through familiar, predictable experiences.
Purposeful experiences guided by a stable central goal.
Repeated experiences that deepen expertise without changing viewpoints.
analyses: A diverse, unusual, interesting experiences that change your perspective 直接支持这一概括，后面的曲折、复杂和转折继续展开这个特征。
B 当前句强调不同寻常、多样和视角改变，并未以熟悉、可预测的满足感定义心理丰富。
C 句中没有把稳定的核心目标设为定义标准；这里的重点是经历的多样性和视角变化。
D without changing viewpoints 与 change your perspective 相反；反复进行同样的活动也与同一跑道绕圈这一对照意象更接近。

evidence.quote: A psychologically rich life is a life filled with diverse, unusual, interesting experiences that change your perspective;

vocabulary.context: 有些经历会改变看待世界的方式
vocabulary.example: Travel gave her a new perspective on work.

questions.editorialStatus: 短段版 v2；连续原句，配题片段互不重叠；保留 v1 历史快照，不重算旧成绩
questions.translation: 心理丰富的人生，充满多样、不同寻常、有趣且能改变视角的经历；它曲折多变，充满戏剧性与事件，而非简单平直；它有多重性与复杂性，有许多停顿、绕道与转折；它感觉像漫长蜿蜒的徒步，而不是在同一个跑道上反复绕圈。
questions.promptZh: 作者定义的心理丰富人生，其核心特征是什么？
optionsZh: 多样且能改变个人视角的经历。
通过熟悉、可预测的经历维持个人满足感。
由稳定的核心目标引导的有目的经历。
加深专长却不改变视角的重复经历。

questions.passage: Then, in 1989, Carol Ryff published a paper entitled “Happiness Is Everything, or Is It?,” presenting an alternative model of a good life that focused on autonomy, self-acceptance, purpose, positive relations, environmental mastery, and personal growth.
questions.prompt: Which combination belongs to Carol Ryff’s alternative model described here?
options: Autonomy, purpose, and personal growth.
Self-acceptance, social status, and personal growth.
Positive relations, obedience, and environmental mastery.
Physical comfort, purpose, and self-acceptance.
questions.promptZh: 哪组要素属于这里描述的 Carol Ryff 的替代模型？
optionsZh: 自主性、目标感和个人成长。
自我接纳、社会地位和个人成长。
积极关系、服从和环境掌控。
身体舒适、目标感和自我接纳。
analyses: A autonomy、purpose 和 personal growth 都出现在原文的六项要素中。
B 自我接纳与个人成长在清单中，但 social status 不在。不能因两项正确就接受整组。
C positive relations 与 environmental mastery 在清单中，但 obedience 不在；原文写的是 autonomy。
D purpose 和 self-acceptance 在清单中，physical comfort 不在。此题要求整组均属于模型。

evidence.quote: an alternative model of a good life that focused on autonomy, self-acceptance, purpose, positive relations, environmental mastery, and personal growth.

vocabulary.context: Ryff 模型列出的一个维度，并非免除全部责任
vocabulary.example: The course gives learners greater autonomy over their schedules.

questions.translation: 随后在 1989 年，Carol Ryff 发表了题为《Happiness Is Everything, or Is It?》的论文，提出一种关于美好生活的替代模型，关注自主性、自我接纳、目标感、积极关系、环境掌控和个人成长。
questions.editorialStatus: 按第 1 章 PDF 第 9–16 页具体原文编写；保持已发布短段边界；区分叙事、研究概括、比喻与引文

questions.passage: Along with Ed Deci and Richard Ryan’s self-determination theory, Ryff’s approach to the good life has come to be called the “eudaimonic approach”—a meaningful life, in short —in contrast to Ed Diener, Daniel Kahneman, Dan Gilbert, Sonja Lyubomirsky, and others’ approach to the good life, which has come to be called the “hedonic approach”—a happy life.
questions.prompt: How does the passage distinguish the eudaimonic and hedonic approaches?
options: Happiness in the former; meaning in the latter.
The former is linked to Diener; the latter to Ryff.
Meaning in the former; happiness in the latter.
The former concerns purpose; the latter rejects pleasure.
analyses: A 将两种取向的对应关系颠倒：原文把 eudaimonic 概括为 meaningful life，把 hedonic 概括为 happy life。
B 把人物归属颠倒。句中 Ryff 一侧对应 eudaimonic，Diener 等人一侧对应 hedonic。
C 两个破折号后的 a meaningful life 与 a happy life 直接支持前者意义、后者幸福的对应。
D 后半项 rejects pleasure 没有原文依据，不能从 happy life 推出排斥愉悦；一部分听似合理也不能使整项成立。

evidence.quote: the “eudaimonic approach”—a meaningful life, in short
the “hedonic approach”—a happy life.

vocabulary.context: 侧重有意义生活的研究取向
vocabulary.example: The eudaimonic approach considers purpose and development.

questions.editorialStatus: 短段版 v2；连续原句，配题片段互不重叠；保留 v1 历史快照，不重算旧成绩
questions.translation: 里夫关于美好生活的取向，与埃德·德西和理查德·瑞安的自我决定理论一起，被称为“实现论取向”——简言之，是有意义的生活。与之相对，埃德·迪纳、丹尼尔·卡尼曼、丹·吉尔伯特、索尼娅·柳博米尔斯基等人的取向被称为“享乐论取向”——幸福的生活。
questions.promptZh: 文中如何区分实现论取向与享乐论取向？
optionsZh: 前者关联幸福，后者关联意义。
前者关联迪纳，后者关联里夫。
前者关联意义，后者关联幸福。
前者关注目的，后者排斥愉悦。

questions.passage: How we think about our intelligence—specifically, whether we believe that intelligence can be improved—is also important in predicting intelligence and human performance, she showed.
questions.prompt: Which belief is singled out as relevant to predicting intelligence and performance?
options: People's performance depends on inherited intelligence alone.
How people view their intelligence makes little predictive difference.
Improving performance means accepting one's current intellectual limits.
Intelligence is something that can be improved.
questions.promptZh: 哪种观念被特别指出与预测智力和表现有关？
optionsZh: 人的表现只取决于遗传的智力。
人们如何看待自己的智力，对预测几乎没有影响。
提升表现意味着接受自己现有的智力上限。
智力是可以得到提高的。
analyses: A 当前句没有把表现归结为遗传这一唯一因素，反而强调人如何看待自己的智力也很重要。
B little predictive difference 与 also important in predicting 相反。
C 句子特别指出能否提高的信念，没有把接受固定上限作为提升表现的含义。
D whether we believe that intelligence can be improved 明确指出所谈的信念。题目问的是哪种观念被提及，不是仅凭本句证明任何人的智力都一定会提高。

evidence.quote: whether we believe that intelligence can be improved—is also important in predicting intelligence and human performance

vocabulary.context: 此处说观念对预测表现有重要性，不等于独自决定表现
vocabulary.example: Past practice can be useful in predicting future performance.

questions.translation: 她指出，我们如何看待自己的智力——具体说，是否相信智力可以提高——对于预测智力和人的表现也很重要。
questions.editorialStatus: 按第 1 章 PDF 第 9–16 页具体原文编写；保持已发布短段边界；区分叙事、研究概括、比喻与引文

questions.passage: My son’s suggestion motivated me to fix the window and become a better handyman, a small example of how concepts like growth mindsets broaden the way we think about the self, others, and the world.
questions.prompt: What effect did the son’s comment have on the author?
options: It persuaded him to leave repairs to experienced workers.
It encouraged him to attempt a practical repair.
It shifted his attention from repair skills to family relationships.
It convinced him that thinking patterns matter more than practice.
analyses: A 原句是 motivated me to fix the window，即激励作者自己去修窗，没有说把工作交给工人。
B motivated me to fix the window and become a better handyman 对应鼓励尝试维修、提升动手能力的方向；本句未具体报告维修是否完成或结果如何。
C others 出现在看待自我、他人与世界的概括中，不表示作者放弃维修、转而处理家庭关系。
D 概念拓宽思考范围并不等于把思维和实践排出高低顺序；作者正把修窗作为实际行动的例子。

evidence.quote: My son’s suggestion motivated me to fix the window and become a better handyman

vocabulary.context: 儿子的建议促使作者尝试修窗
vocabulary.example: The challenge motivated her to practise daily.

vocabulary.context: 关于能力是否可以提升的看法
vocabulary.example: Feedback can help students develop a growth mindset.

questions.editorialStatus: 短段版 v2；连续原句，配题片段互不重叠；保留 v1 历史快照，不重算旧成绩
questions.translation: 儿子的建议激励我去修窗户，并努力成为一个更擅长动手维修的人。这是一个小例子，说明成长型思维这样的概念如何拓宽我们看待自我、他人和世界的方式。
questions.promptZh: 儿子的评论对作者产生了什么影响？
optionsZh: 它说服他把维修交给有经验的工人。
它鼓励他尝试亲自动手维修。
它使他的注意力从维修技能转向家庭关系。
它使他相信思维模式比实践更重要。

questions.passage: How, then, is psychological richness different from happiness and meaning? The main body of my book answers this question in detail (see Table 1 for a brief summary). But, very briefly, happiness is a subjective feeling that rises and falls to indicate where one’s life stands. It is a bit like a balloon.
questions.prompt: Which feature of happiness is introduced by the balloon comparison?
options: It steadily grows as a person's experiences accumulate.
It supplies a stable purpose that gives life direction.
It reflects the variety of experiences a person collects.
It fluctuates as a subjective feeling about one's life.
questions.promptZh: 气球的比较首先引出了幸福的哪种特征？
optionsZh: 它随着个人经历的积累而稳定增长。
它提供赋予人生方向的稳定目的。
它反映个人积累的经历有多丰富多样。
它是一种关于自身生活、会起伏的主观感受。
analyses: A steadily grows 与原文 rises and falls 不同；起伏不能改成稳定单向增长。
B 当前片段把 happiness 定义为 subjective feeling，没有把它定义为稳定的人生目的。
C 当前定义强调生活处境的主观感受及其起伏，没有用经历的多样性来界定幸福。
D subjective feeling that rises and falls 直接支持这一改写；气球用于说明起落的特征。

evidence.quote: happiness is a subjective feeling that rises and falls to indicate where one’s life stands. It is a bit like a balloon.

vocabulary.context: 幸福被描述为个人感受到的状态，而非客观财富总数
vocabulary.example: Comfort is partly a subjective judgement.

questions.translation: 那么，心理丰富与幸福和意义有什么不同？本书主体会详细回答这个问题，表 1 则提供简要总结。不过，简而言之，幸福是一种会上下起伏、反映人生当前处境的主观感受。它有点像气球。
questions.editorialStatus: 按第 1 章 PDF 第 9–16 页具体原文编写；保持已发布短段边界；区分叙事、研究概括、比喻与引文

questions.passage: Tolstoy was happy and productive. Yet, without any obvious loss, he had a sudden existential crisis at about the age of fifty (years after the publication of War and Peace): “I had a good wife who loved me and whom I loved; good children and a large property which was increasing with no pains taken on my part. I was more respected by my kinsfolk and acquaintance than I had ever been; I was loaded with praise by strangers; and without exaggeration I could believe my name already famous…. And yet I could give no reasonable meaning to any actions of my life.”
questions.prompt: What does Tolstoy’s example suggest within this discussion?
options: Success and affection need not ensure meaning.
A loss of public recognition triggered his crisis.
His productive work supplied a stable sense of purpose.
His family relationships weakened before his crisis began.
analyses: A 他有相爱的妻子、孩子、财产和赞誉，却仍无法为人生行动赋予合理意义。这是个案支持的有限概括：这些条件未必保证意义感。
B 引述说明他得到比以往更多的尊重与赞誉，没有报告失去公众认可，更没有确立这种因果。
C happy and productive 与末句无法赋予意义形成反差，不能把工作多产改成意义感稳定。
D 引述描述相爱的夫妻关系和好孩子，没有报告危机前家庭关系恶化。

evidence.quote: Tolstoy was happy and productive.

Yet, without any obvious loss, he had a sudden existential crisis at about the age of fifty (years after the publication of War and Peace): “I had a good wife who loved me and whom I loved; good children and a large property which was increasing with no pains taken on my part.
And yet I could give no reasonable meaning to any actions of my life.

vocabulary.meaning: 存在危机；对人生意义的深刻疑问
vocabulary.context: 外在生活顺利时仍出现的意义危机
vocabulary.example: The novel follows a writer facing an existential crisis.

questions.editorialStatus: 短段版 v2；连续原句，配题片段互不重叠；保留 v1 历史快照，不重算旧成绩
questions.translation: 托尔斯泰曾幸福而多产。然而，在没有明显损失的情况下，他在大约五十岁时，也就是《战争与和平》出版多年后，突然经历存在危机：“我有一个爱我、我也爱的好妻子；有好孩子，还有一大片无需我费力就不断增值的地产。我比以往更受亲友尊敬，陌生人对我赞誉有加；毫不夸张地说，我相信自己的名字已经出名……然而，我却无法为自己人生中的任何行动赋予合理意义。”
questions.promptZh: 在这段讨论中，托尔斯泰的例子说明什么？
optionsZh: 成功和亲密关爱未必能保证意义感。
失去公众认可引发了他的危机。
多产的工作为他提供了稳定的目标感。
他的家庭关系在危机开始前已经恶化。

questions.passage: Psychological richness is different from happiness and meaning in the sense that it is not about an overall feeling of where life is going or what the point of your life is, but about an experience, or more precisely the accumulation of experiences over time. In the same way that material richness can be quantified by money—the more money you have, the richer you are materially—psychological richness can be quantified by experiences. The more interesting experiences and stories you have, the more psychologically rich you are.
questions.prompt: What distinguishes psychological richness in this passage?
options: The gradual accumulation of interesting experiences.
A current feeling of satisfaction with one's life.
Commitment to a coherent purpose throughout one's life.
The financial wealth spent on unusual experiences.
questions.promptZh: 本段用什么特征区分心理丰富？
optionsZh: 有趣经历随着时间逐渐积累。
对自己当前生活感到满意。
一生致力于一个连贯的目标。
为了不同寻常的经历而花费的财力。
analyses: A the accumulation of experiences over time 与末句 interesting experiences and stories 直接支持以有趣经历的积累区分心理丰富。
B 作者用 not about an overall feeling 排除把它直接等同于人生总体感受，不能改为当前满意感。
C what the point of your life is 被列为与心理丰富不同的关注方向，不能把它重新定义为坚持单一目的。
D money 在本段用于类比 material richness，心理丰富对应的是经历，不是为经历花了多少钱。

evidence.quote: it is not about an overall feeling of where life is going or what the point of your life is, but about an experience, or more precisely the accumulation of experiences over time.
The more interesting experiences and stories you have, the more psychologically rich you are.

vocabulary.context: 作者把经历与金钱作类比，说明丰富可以累积，并未在此提供统一计分公式
vocabulary.example: The benefits cannot always be quantified in a single number.

questions.translation: 心理丰富不同于幸福和意义：它关注的不是人生走向的总体感受，也不是人生的目的，而是经历，更准确地说，是随着时间累积的经历。正如物质丰富可以用金钱量化——钱越多，物质上越富有——心理丰富也可以用经历来量化。有趣的经历和故事越多，心理上就越丰富。
questions.editorialStatus: 按第 1 章 PDF 第 9–16 页具体原文编写；保持已发布短段边界；区分叙事、研究概括、比喻与引文

questions.passage: At bottom, these simpletons want a single thing most of all: that nobody should hurt them. Thus they try to please and gratify everybody. This, however, is cowardice, even if it be called virtue.”
questions.prompt: In the quoted passage, why is pleasing everybody criticised?
options: It enables conventional virtue to challenge their desire for safety.
It places moral independence above their wish for approval.
It is motivated by fear of being hurt.
It makes accepting danger more important than gaining approval.
analyses: A 原文说这些人最想不受伤害，因此讨好众人，并将其批评为怯懦；没有说他们用美德挑战求安全的愿望。
B nobody should hurt them 后接 Thus they try to please，说明动机是避免受伤，不是坚持独立的道德立场。
C nobody should hurt them 与 Thus 形成清楚的动机关系；cowardice 是引述对这种讨好的评价，而不是研究的实验结论。
D 接受危险并不是当前片段给出的讨好动机；它与避免受伤的愿望方向相反。

evidence.quote: At bottom, these simpletons want a single thing most of all: that nobody should hurt them. Thus they try to please and gratify everybody. This, however, is cowardice, even if it be called virtue.

vocabulary.context: 尼采引述中为避免受伤而迎合众人的行为
vocabulary.example: The result will gratify the supporters.

vocabulary.context: 引述质疑被称作美德的怯懦与迎合
vocabulary.example: Patience is a virtue worth practising.

questions.editorialStatus: 短段版 v2；连续原句，配题片段互不重叠；保留 v1 历史快照，不重算旧成绩
questions.translation: 归根结底，这些愚人最渴望的只有一件事：没有人伤害他们。因此，他们试着讨好、取悦所有人。然而这就是怯懦，即使它被称作美德。
questions.promptZh: 在所引片段中，为什么批评取悦所有人？
optionsZh: 它让传统美德挑战他们寻求安全的愿望。
它把道德独立置于获得认可的愿望之上。
它出于害怕受到伤害的动机。
它让接受危险比获得认可更重要。

questions.passage: Well, the bad news is that those who got tenure were not as happy as the current assistant professors imagined.
questions.prompt: What comparison does this sentence make?
options: Tenured professors were less happy than colleagues denied tenure.
Post-tenure happiness fell short of assistant professors' expectations.
Assistant professors expected tenure to lower their own happiness.
Tenure recipients became less happy than before their appointments.
questions.promptZh: 这句话作了什么比较？
optionsZh: 获终身教职者比未获终身教职的同事更不幸福。
获得终身教职后的幸福程度低于助理教授的预想。
助理教授预期获得终身教职会降低自己的幸福程度。
终身教职获得者比获得该职位前更不幸福。
analyses: A 本句比较实际幸福与 current assistant professors 的预想，不是在比较获得与未获得终身教职的两组人。
B not as happy as ... imagined 表明实际幸福程度低于预想；较低于预期不等于绝对不幸福。
C 原句报告获得者没有预想得那么幸福，没有说预测者原本预期会下降。
D 前后实际变化与实际对照预期是不同的比较，本句没有提供同一批人任职前后的幸福数据。

evidence.quote: those who got tenure were not as happy as the current assistant professors imagined.

vocabulary.context: 修饰预测的幸福程度，区别实际经历
vocabulary.example: The course was more demanding than she had imagined.

questions.translation: 那么，坏消息是，获得终身教职的人，并没有现任助理教授想象的那么幸福。

questions.passage: They were given an empty envelope for any stickers they wanted to donate to an anonymous classmate. After the session was over, the researcher counted how many stickers each child donated as a behavioral measure of altruistic giving. Before the earthquake, nine-year-olds gave, on average, slightly more than one out of the ten stickers. One month after the earthquake, nine-year-olds gave, on average, about four out of the ten stickers.
questions.prompt: What served as the behavioural measure of altruistic giving?
questions.promptZh: 什么被用作利他给予的行为测量？
options: The number of stickers still displayed in the original set of one hundred.
The number of stickers each child actually donated, counted after the session.
Only the child's claim that they were generous, without counting donations.
The number of classmates who had not been selected, regardless of what the child gave.
optionsZh: 原来一百张中仍在展示的数量。
结束后数每名儿童实际捐出的贴纸数量。
只听儿童自称慷慨，不数捐赠。
未被选中同学的数量，不管儿童实际给多少。
analyses: A 测量的是每名儿童实际捐出的贴纸数，不是原始展示的一百张还剩多少。
B after the session was over、counted how many stickers 和 each child donated 共同说明测量时点、动作和对象。
C behavioral measure 在这里通过实际捐赠行为取得，不是只询问儿童是否自认慷慨。
D 未获选同学的人数不是每名儿童的捐赠量；捐出的贴纸数量才是本题所问的指标。

vocabulary.meaning: 行为测量；以实际行为数量等作为指标
vocabulary.context: 此处贴纸捐出数是操作性指标，不穷尽一个人的全部道德品格。
vocabulary.example: The number of items donated was used as a behavioral measure.
collocations: a behavioral measure of altruistic giving
counted how many stickers each child donated

questions.translation: 他们拿空信封，装想捐给一名匿名同学的贴纸。结束后，研究者数捐出数量，作为利他给予的行为测量。震前九岁儿童平均捐十张中略多于一张；震后一月平均约四张。

evidence.quote: After the session was over, the researcher counted how many stickers each child donated as a behavioral measure of altruistic giving.

questions.passage: Why so down on happiness? One common critique is that a happy life might be a selfish one. In reality, there is lots of evidence that suggests otherwise. For example, spending money on others as opposed to on oneself increases happiness.
questions.prompt: How does the spending example relate to the critique of happiness?
options: It shows how self-directed spending explains generosity to others.
It challenges the proposed link between happiness and selfishness.
It treats the two kinds of spending as equally effective.
It presents personal financial gain as the basis of happiness.
questions.promptZh: 花钱的例子与对幸福的批评是什么关系？
optionsZh: 它说明为自己花钱如何解释对他人的慷慨。
它对把幸福与自私相联系的批评提出质疑。
它把两种花钱方式视为同样有效。
它把个人财务收益视为幸福的基础。
analyses: A 例子的支出对象是 others，与 on oneself 对照，并没有用自我导向的消费来解释慷慨。
B otherwise 引出反向证据：为别人花钱也与幸福增加相联系。这里挑战的是批评所提出的联系，不把 might 偷换为必然自私，也不声称任何幸福的人都不可能自私。
C as opposed to 表示支出对象的对比，当前句没有报告两种方式效果相同。
D 例子说的是把钱花给谁，不是个人赚到更多钱；不能把支出对象换成财务收益。

evidence.quote: One common critique is that a happy life might be a selfish one. In reality, there is lots of evidence that suggests otherwise.
spending money on others as opposed to on oneself increases happiness.

vocabulary.context: 在此对比消费的受益者：别人和自己
vocabulary.example: The session focuses on practice as opposed to theory.

questions.translation: 为什么如此贬低幸福？一种常见批评认为，幸福的生活可能是自私的生活。实际上，有大量证据指向相反的情况。例如，把钱花在别人身上而不是自己身上，会增加幸福感。

questions.passage: Happy people volunteer more than unhappy people. But, for now, let’s assume the critique of happiness-as-selfishness and proceed with a question: What makes for a good life, if not happiness?
questions.prompt: Why does the author temporarily assume the happiness-as-selfishness critique?
options: To set aside the evidence about volunteering as unreliable.
To investigate whether selfish behaviour produces lasting happiness.
To replace a question about good lives with one about generosity.
To consider sources of a good life beyond happiness.
questions.promptZh: 作者为什么暂时接受“幸福即自私”的批评作假定？
optionsZh: 把关于志愿服务的证据视为不可靠而搁置。
调查自私行为能否产生持久幸福。
用关于慷慨的问题替代关于美好生活的问题。
考察幸福之外构成美好生活的来源。
analyses: A for now, let’s assume 是暂时采用一种讨论前提，不表示认定志愿服务证据不可靠。
B 随后的问题是 What makes for a good life, if not happiness，并非自私行为能否制造持久幸福。
C 作者保留了关于美好生活的问题，只是暂时把幸福放在一边，并未把问题替换成如何慷慨。
D proceed with a question 后直接问如果不是幸福，什么构成美好生活，说明这样设定是为了展开其他可能性。

evidence.quote: for now, let’s assume the critique of happiness-as-selfishness and proceed with a question: What makes for a good life, if not happiness?

vocabulary.context: 这里为动词，比较志愿服务多寡，不是职业名称
vocabulary.example: I volunteer at the community garden on Saturdays.

questions.translation: 幸福的人比不幸福的人做更多志愿服务。不过，目前先让我们接受“幸福就是自私”这一批评作为假定，接着问：如果不是幸福，什么能构成美好生活？

questions.passage: But if you are not making any positive difference in the world, your life may feel pointless. Likewise, a meaningless life has no clear purpose. People without a clear purpose tend to go through their lives aimlessly. Finally, a meaningless life feels torn and highly fragmented.
questions.prompt: Which combination characterises the meaningless life described here?
options: Strong positive impact, unclear purpose, and fragmented experience.
No positive impact, a clear purpose, and fragmented experience.
No positive impact, unclear purpose, and fragmented experience.
No positive impact, unclear purpose, and an integrated life.
questions.promptZh: 哪组特征概括这里描述的无意义生活？
optionsZh: 强烈的正面影响、不明确的目的和破碎的体验。
没有正面影响、目的明确和破碎的体验。
没有正面影响、目的不明确和破碎的体验。
没有正面影响、目的不明确和整合成一体的生活。
analyses: A not making any positive difference 与 strong positive impact 不符；另外两项相似也不能使整组成立。
B no clear purpose 与 a clear purpose 方向相反。
C 三项分别对应 not making any positive difference、no clear purpose 和 torn and highly fragmented；这是当前片段描述的特征组合，不是对每个人作诊断。
D an integrated life 与 highly fragmented 相反，把整体感这一项颠倒了。

evidence.quote: if you are not making any positive difference in the world, your life may feel pointless.
a meaningless life has no clear purpose.
a meaningless life feels torn and highly fragmented.

vocabulary.context: 描述缺乏清晰目标时生活的走向，不是空间上迷路
vocabulary.example: He spent the afternoon wandering aimlessly.

questions.translation: 但如果你没有给世界带来任何正面影响，你的人生可能会让你觉得毫无意义。同样，无意义的生活没有明确目的。没有明确目的的人往往漫无目标地度过人生。最后，无意义的生活让人感到撕裂、极为破碎。

questions.passage: Needless to say, a meaningful life sounds a lot more appealing than a meaningless one. Thus, people say you should find a reason for living— whether via career, religion, social roles (e.g., parenthood), scientific discovery, or social change. Many commencement speakers preach along these lines, including Michelle Obama in her speech to CUNY’s class of 2016: “Be great. Build great lives for yourselves….
questions.prompt: Which statement accurately reflects the routes to a reason for living listed here?
options: Career, religion, social rank, scientific discovery, and social change.
Career, religion, parenthood, income growth, and scientific discovery.
Religion, parenthood, scientific discovery, personal fame, and social change.
Career, religion, social roles, scientific discovery, and social change.
questions.promptZh: 哪一项准确反映这里列举的人生理由的来源？
optionsZh: 事业、宗教、社会等级、科学发现和社会变革。
事业、宗教、为人父母、收入增长和科学发现。
宗教、为人父母、科学发现、个人名气和社会变革。
事业、宗教、社会角色、科学发现和社会变革。
analyses: A social roles 指社会角色，不能替换为社会等级 social rank；其余词相同也掩盖不了这一错配。
B parenthood 是社会角色的例子，但 income growth 不在本段清单中。
C personal fame 不在所列途径中；列举人物演讲也不等于把出名设为途径。
D 五项与 whether via 后的并列清单逐项对应。whether ... or 列出可能来源，不要求每个人同时走完所有途径。

evidence.quote: whether via career, religion, social roles (e.g., parenthood), scientific discovery, or social change.

vocabulary.context: commencement speakers 指毕业典礼演讲者，此处不是项目开工者
vocabulary.example: She was invited to give a commencement address.

questions.translation: 不用说，有意义的生活听起来比无意义的生活更有吸引力。因此，人们说你应该找到活着的理由——可以通过事业、宗教、社会角色（如为人父母）、科学发现或社会变革来寻找。许多毕业典礼演讲者都作过类似劝勉，包括 Michelle Obama 在纽约市立大学 2016 届毕业典礼上的话：“成就伟大。为你们自己建立出色的人生……”

questions.passage: Dr. Donna Adams-Pickett did exactly what Michele Obama promoted. As a child, she learned that her paternal grandmother, who lived on a tobacco farm, died while giving birth. The baby died as well, and her father was left motherless at age twelve. After hearing this story, she was determined to become an ob-gyn doctor.
questions.prompt: What event led Donna Adams-Pickett to decide to become an ob-gyn doctor?
options: Learning that her father had chosen medicine after losing his mother.
Discovering that her grandmother had worked in maternal healthcare.
Hearing about her grandmother's and the baby's deaths in childbirth.
Experiencing her own mother's death while she was twelve years old.
questions.promptZh: 什么事件促使 Donna Adams-Pickett 决定成为妇产科医生？
optionsZh: 得知父亲在失去母亲后选择了从医。
发现祖母曾从事孕产妇医疗照护。
听到祖母与婴儿在分娩中去世的故事。
自己十二岁时经历了母亲去世。
analyses: A 原文说父亲十二岁失去母亲，决定成为妇产科医生的是 Donna，不能把职业选择移给父亲。
B tobacco farm 是祖母的生活地点，没有说祖母在孕产医疗领域工作。
C 祖母分娩时去世，婴儿也死亡；After hearing this story 直接连接这一家庭故事与 Donna 的从医决心。
D 十二岁失母的是她的父亲，不是 Donna 本人；paternal grandmother 也不能换成她自己的母亲。

evidence.quote: her paternal grandmother, who lived on a tobacco farm, died while giving birth. The baby died as well
After hearing this story, she was determined to become an ob-gyn doctor.

vocabulary.context: paternal grandmother 指父亲的母亲，即祖母
vocabulary.example: His paternal grandfather grew up near the coast.

questions.translation: Donna Adams-Pickett 医生确实践行了 Michele Obama 所提倡的事。小时候，她得知住在烟草农场的祖母在分娩时去世，婴儿也没能活下来，她父亲十二岁就失去了母亲。听到这个故事后，她下定决心成为妇产科医生。

questions.passage: As she shared with PBS NewsHour, Dr. Adams-Pickett delivered over 6,000 babies over the last twenty years in Augusta, Georgia, an area located in a maternity care desert. Her life is certainly meaningful, as she has a clear purpose (provide good maternal care to the people of Georgia, especially Black women, who have a much higher rate of maternal mortality before and after delivery than other women) and significance (some mothers and babies might have died without her care).
questions.prompt: How does the author illustrate significance in Dr. Adams-Pickett’s life?
options: By pointing to the clear professional goal that guides her work.
By noting that her care may have saved mothers and babies.
By explaining how her family history gives her life coherence.
By treating her television interview as evidence of public recognition.
questions.promptZh: 作者怎样说明 Adams-Pickett 医生人生的重要性？
optionsZh: 指出引导她工作的明确职业目标。
指出她的照护可能挽救了母亲与婴儿。
解释她的家族经历如何让人生具有连贯性。
把她的电视采访视为公众认可的证据。
analyses: A clear purpose 是作者在同一句中区分出的目的维度，本题问 significance，不能把两个维度混用。
B significance 后明确写 some mothers and babies might have died without her care。可能避免死亡对应可能挽救生命，保留 some 与 might 的范围，没有声称已确定挽救了每个人。
C 家族经历与连贯性的联系并不是当前句对 significance 给出的解释；本句把重要性落在照护可能带来的生命影响上。
D PBS NewsHour 是叙述的信息出处，不是作者用来界定重要性的指标；出镜也不能自动改写为公众认可。

evidence.quote: significance (some mothers and babies might have died without her care).

vocabulary.meaning: 孕产照护资源匮乏地区
vocabulary.context: 用 desert 比喻照护资源稀少的地区，并非气候沙漠
vocabulary.example: The report describes efforts to serve a maternity care desert.
collocations: live in a maternity care desert

questions.translation: Adams-Pickett 医生向 PBS《新闻时刻》分享说，过去二十年，她在佐治亚州奥古斯塔接生了六千多名婴儿；当地是孕产照护资源匮乏地区。她的人生无疑有意义：有明确目的——为佐治亚居民提供良好孕产照护，尤其关注分娩前后孕产死亡率远高于其他女性的黑人女性；也有重要性——如果没有她的照护，一些母亲与婴儿可能已经死亡。

questions.passage: Like the happiness trap, there is also a meaning trap. The first element of the meaning trap is that the type of accomplishment associated with a meaningful life is so grand that aiming for it will set us up for a failure.
questions.prompt: What is the first element of the meaning trap?
options: Giving up meaningful goals in order to protect one's happiness.
Mistaking a clear sense of purpose for a public achievement.
Expecting such grand accomplishments that failure becomes more likely.
Treating an achieved goal as the end of personal development.
questions.promptZh: 意义陷阱的第一个因素是什么？
optionsZh: 为保护自己的幸福而放弃有意义的目标。
把明确的目的感误当作公开的成就。
期待过于宏大的成就，使自己更容易遭遇失败。
把一个目标的达成视为个人发展的终点。
analyses: A 当前片段指出的是对成就的期待过高，没有说人们为了幸福而放弃目标。
B 问题是把与意义关联的成就设得过于宏大，不是把个人目的感误认成一项公开成就。
C so grand ... aiming for it will set us up for a failure 表达宏大门槛使人处于容易失败的境地；这是一种陷阱的解释，不是每个人都必然失败的统计定律。
D 本段没有讨论达成目标之后停止成长，而是讨论追求过于宏大成就时的困难。

evidence.quote: the type of accomplishment associated with a meaningful life is so grand that aiming for it will set us up for a failure.

vocabulary.meaning: 使我们容易遭遇；使我们陷入
vocabulary.context: 这里指宏大标准使追求者容易落入失败，不是预订安排
vocabulary.example: Unrealistic deadlines can set a team up for failure.

questions.translation: 就像幸福陷阱一样，也存在意义陷阱。意义陷阱的第一个因素是：人们把有意义的生活与过于宏大的成就联系起来，以至于追求那种成就会让自己容易遭遇失败。

questions.passage: In the cleverly entitled paper “Life Is Pretty Meaningful,” Samantha Heintzelman and Laura King report that 90 percent of Americans said they have meaning in life, according to the Gallup World Polls.
questions.prompt: What does the reported 90 percent represent?
options: Americans who said their lives lacked a clear purpose.
People worldwide whose lives the researchers judged meaningful.
Americans selecting the highest purpose score on a five-point scale.
Americans' self-reported meaning in the cited Gallup poll.
questions.promptZh: 这里报告的 90% 代表什么？
optionsZh: 说自己的人生缺少明确目的的美国人。
全世界由研究者判定其人生有意义的人。
在五点量表上选择最高目的感分数的美国人。
所引 Gallup 调查中美国人自报的人生意义感。
analyses: A 原句是 said they have meaning in life，不能改成自报缺乏目的。
B Americans 被扩大成全球人群，said 也被替换成研究者判断，两个范围都不符。
C 当前句没有把 90% 定义为五点量表的最高分组；不能把自报有意义与强烈同意混为同一指标。
D 90 percent of Americans said ... according to the Gallup World Polls 同时确定了人群、自报性质和调查来源。

evidence.quote: 90 percent of Americans said they have meaning in life, according to the Gallup World Polls.

vocabulary.context: 此处为动词，主语是论文作者，结果来自 Gallup 数据
vocabulary.example: The researchers report a difference between the two groups.

questions.translation: Samantha Heintzelman 和 Laura King 在题名巧妙的论文《人生颇有意义》中报告说，根据 Gallup 世界民意调查，90% 的美国人说自己人生有意义。

questions.passage: To say, “No, my life has no purpose nor meaning,” is almost to say one’s life is pointless. Those who did not feel like their lives were utterly pointless were likely to say yes to this question. This means that even if someone did not feel their life was particularly meaningful, they might have said yes.
questions.prompt: Why might someone answer yes without finding life particularly meaningful?
options: The question asks them to rate happiness rather than life meaning.
They understand yes as proof of notable personal achievements.
A no could imply a stronger rejection than they feel.
They mistake the yes-or-no format for a scale of strong agreement.
questions.promptZh: 为什么一个不觉得人生特别有意义的人仍可能回答“是”？
optionsZh: 这个问题让他们评价幸福而不是人生意义。
他们把回答“是”理解为显著个人成就的证明。
回答“否”可能意味着比他们实际感受更强烈的否定。
他们把是非题格式误认为表示强烈同意程度的量表。
analyses: A 当前片段围绕 purpose、meaning 和 pointless 展开，没有把所问内容改成幸福评分。
B 原文没有说回答是认证了显著成就；作者解释的是对 utterly pointless 这一强烈否定的距离。
C 不觉得人生特别有意义，并不等于觉得人生全然无意义。因此，一个人可能觉得否定过于强烈而回答是；could 保留原文 might 的可能性。
D 本段没有报告受访者把问卷格式认错。对否定强度的解释不能改写为误把是非题当成评分量表。

evidence.quote: Those who did not feel like their lives were utterly pointless were likely to say yes to this question.
even if someone did not feel their life was particularly meaningful, they might have said yes.

vocabulary.context: 修饰 pointless，把否定选项理解成非常强的否定
vocabulary.example: The two accounts are utterly different.

questions.translation: 说“不，我的人生既无目的也无意义”，几乎等于说自己的人生毫无价值。那些不觉得自己的人生全然无意义的人，很可能会回答“是”。这意味着，即便某人并不觉得自己的人生特别有意义，也可能回答“是”。

questions.passage: Psychologist Michael Steger and colleagues asked participants to report how meaningful they feel their lives are. In addition, he asked their friends and family members to report the participant’s meaning in life. If the high percentage of self-reported meaning in life is only an illusion, informant reports would not correlate with self-reports. What he found was different: self-reported meaning in life is correlated with informant-reported meaning in life.
questions.prompt: Which finding challenges the idea that reported meaning is only an illusion?
options: Participants and informants were describing different people's lives.
Participants and informants gave the same average level of meaning.
Self-reports correlated with friends' and relatives' reports.
The meaning reports correlated with participants' income instead.
questions.promptZh: 哪个发现挑战了“自报意义感只是幻觉”的解释？
optionsZh: 参与者和知情人在描述不同人的生活。
参与者和知情人给出的平均意义感水平相同。
自报与朋友和亲属的报告存在相关。
意义感报告与参与者的收入存在相关。
analyses: A 朋友和家人评价的是该参与者的生命意义，不能把双方评定对象改成不同的人。
B 相关描述两组评分如何共同变化，不等于两组平均值相同；原文也没有报告均值相等。
C 原文以 self-reported meaning ... is correlated with informant-reported meaning 对照只是一种幻觉的解释，跨报告者相关是本题所问的发现。
D 本段没有报告收入相关，把知情人报告这个变量换成了收入。

evidence.quote: If the high percentage of self-reported meaning in life is only an illusion, informant reports would not correlate with self-reports.
self-reported meaning in life is correlated with informant-reported meaning in life.

vocabulary.context: 这里特指对参与者作评价的朋友和家人，不是警方线人
vocabulary.example: An informant who knew the participant completed the questionnaire.

questions.translation: 心理学家 Michael Steger 与同事请参与者报告自己觉得人生多有意义。此外，他还请参与者的朋友和家人评价这个人的生命意义。如果自报有意义的高比例只是一种幻觉，知情人的报告便不会与自报相关。他发现的却不同：自报的生命意义与知情人报告的生命意义存在相关。

questions.passage: The self-informant correlation on meaning in life was similar to that in studies testing more familiar personality traits such as extraversion and neuroticism (a tendency to worry excessively). Scientifically, then, self-reports of meaning in life are quite valid.
questions.prompt: Which conclusion stays within the evidence described?
options: Comparable cross-reporter correlations support the meaning measure's validity.
The measure removes the differences between individuals' and informants' ratings.
The personality traits directly explain participants' reported meaning in life.
Meaning reports need identical outside ratings before they can be valid.
questions.promptZh: 哪项结论没有超出所述证据？
optionsZh: 可与常见测量相比的跨报告者相关，为意义感测量的有效性提供支持。
该测量消除了个人与知情人评分之间的差异。
人格特质直接解释了参与者所报告的人生意义。
意义感自报必须得到完全相同的外部评分才可能有效。
analyses: A similar to ... personality traits 是作者判断 quite valid 的比较依据。相关程度相近提供有效性支持，不要求两名报告者给出完全相同的分数。
B 相关不等于差异被消除，原文没有报告每个参与者与知情人的评分完全一致。
C extraversion 与 neuroticism 在这里是其他研究中测量的特质，用于比较跨报告者相关，不是解释意义感的已证原因。
D 有效性不以每一项外部评分都完全相同为前提；本段依据的是相关而非逐项分数相等。

evidence.quote: The self-informant correlation on meaning in life was similar to that in studies testing more familiar personality traits
self-reports of meaning in life are quite valid.

vocabulary.context: 这里是测量有效性评价，不能扩成个体报告绝对无误
vocabulary.example: The team checked whether the measure was valid.

questions.translation: 生命意义上的自报与知情人评价之间的相关，与测量外向性、神经质（倾向于过度担忧）等更熟悉的人格特质的研究中的相关程度相似。因此，从科学角度看，生命意义的自报相当有效。
questions.editorialStatus: PDF 第 25–32 页逐题核对；固定连续原句；区分文学引述、自报、相关和假设，不扩大个体或因果结论

questions.passage: In a famous folk legend, when John F. Kennedy once visited NASA he said to a janitor, “Hi, I’m Jack Kennedy. What are you doing?” The janitor replied: “Well, Mr. President, I’m helping put a man on the moon!”
questions.prompt: What does the janitor’s reply illustrate within the story?
options: He sees his ordinary job as contributing to a shared mission.
He understands his job as preparation for becoming an astronaut.
He sees his job's importance as depending on meeting the president.
He describes the specialist task he personally performs on spacecraft.
questions.promptZh: 在这个故事中，清洁工的回答说明什么？
optionsZh: 他把自己的普通工作视为对共同使命的贡献。
他把自己的工作理解为成为宇航员的准备。
他认为工作的分量取决于能否见到总统。
他描述自己亲自在航天器上执行的专业任务。
analyses: A janitor 的工作与 helping put a man on the moon 连接起来，说明普通岗位也可被理解为共同任务的一部分。
B helping 的参与感不等于计划改行成为宇航员，片段没有这样的职业准备。
C 见总统是故事发生的情境，不是清洁工给工作赋予意义的理由。
D 他表达的是对更大任务的认同，没有列举自己在航天器上的专业操作。开头明确标为 folk legend，不能把它当成已核验实验或史料。

evidence.quote: In a famous folk legend
I’m helping put a man on the moon!

vocabulary.context: 故事中承担日常维护工作的人，与宇航员身份不同
vocabulary.example: The janitor opened the building before the staff arrived.

questions.translation: 有个广为流传的民间故事：John F. Kennedy 一次访问 NASA 时，对一名清洁工说：“你好，我是 Jack Kennedy。你在做什么？”清洁工回答：“总统先生，我在帮助把人送上月球！”
questions.editorialStatus: PDF 第 25–32 页逐题核对；固定连续原句；区分文学引述、自报、相关和假设，不扩大个体或因果结论

questions.passage: Second, people with high self-esteem are more likely to say that their lives matter than those who do not like themselves. Non-neurotic people (those who don’t worry too much or are not too stress prone) are more likely to say that their lives have a clear purpose and direction than neurotic people. Conscientious people achieve more of their goals than unconscientious people. Therefore, they are also more likely to feel that they are moving toward a larger goal in life than unconscientious people.
questions.prompt: Which link concerning conscientious people is stated here?
options: They worry more, so they abandon larger goals.
They achieve fewer goals but always rate their lives higher.
They achieve more goals and are more likely to feel they are moving toward a larger one.
They obtain meaning only through having high public status.
questions.promptZh: 这里对尽责者作了哪项联系？
optionsZh: 他们担忧更多，因此放弃更大目标。
他们实现更少目标，却总把人生评价更高。
他们达成更多目标，也更可能觉得正朝人生更大目标前进。
他们只能通过较高公众地位获得意义。
analyses: A non-neurotic 的担忧描述不能误归给所有尽责者。
B achieve more 与 fewer 相反，且 more likely 不是 always。
C 连续两句陈述实现更多目标与更可能感到朝大目标前进。
D 没有 only 或公众地位条件。

evidence.quote: Conscientious people achieve more of their goals than unconscientious people. Therefore, they are also more likely to feel that they are moving toward a larger goal in life

vocabulary.context: 描述较能持续执行责任与目标的人格特质
vocabulary.example: A conscientious colleague checks the details carefully.

questions.translation: 其次，自尊较高的人比不喜欢自己的人更可能说自己的人生有分量。神经质程度较低的人（不太过分担忧，或不那么容易受压力影响的人），比神经质程度较高的人更可能说自己的人生有明确目的和方向。尽责性较高的人比尽责性较低的人能达成更多目标。因此，他们也更可能觉得自己正在朝人生中一个更大的目标前进。

questions.passage: These personality traits and attitudes express themselves in predictable ways. People tend to choose one or two causes they care about dearly (e.g., a soup kitchen, a church), volunteer in the same location for an extended period of time, and achieve meaning by trying to make a difference in a well-defined area. Others derive meaning in life from their work, family, and community, again a narrowly defined realm of life. Research on meaning in life shows that successfully achieving a meaningful life often comes with focus and narrowness.
questions.prompt: What recurring pattern in finding meaning is described?
options: Exploring new causes is the main way to sustain a sense of meaning.
Work and family provide meaning when combined with volunteering.
Meaningful involvement depends on the size of its public audience.
Meaning is often associated with sustained, focused involvement.
questions.promptZh: 这里描述了获得意义的什么常见模式？
optionsZh: 探索新的事业是维持意义感的主要方式。
工作和家庭在与志愿服务结合时提供意义。
有意义的投入取决于其公众受众的规模。
意义感往往与持久、聚焦的投入相伴。
analyses: A 当前片段强调在同一地点长期投入一两个明确领域，没有把不断探索新事业设为主要模式。
B Others derive meaning ... work, family, and community 列出另一组来源，没有把它们与志愿服务的结合设为说明的条件。
C 本段没有以受众规模界定意义；one or two causes 与 well-defined area 强调的是关注和投入的范围。
D extended period of time、well-defined area 与 often comes with focus and narrowness 支持持续而聚焦的概括。associated with 保留伴随关系，不据此新增已证实的因果或人人保证。

evidence.quote: volunteer in the same location for an extended period of time
successfully achieving a meaningful life often comes with focus and narrowness.

vocabulary.context: 指工作、家庭、社区等相对界定清晰的生活范围
vocabulary.example: The discussion moved into the realm of education.

questions.translation: 这些人格特质和态度会以可预期的方式表现出来。人们往往选择一两个格外关心的事业（如施粥所或教会），长期在同一地点做志愿服务，尝试在界定清楚的领域产生影响，从而获得意义。另一些人从工作、家庭和社区获得生命意义，同样是相对狭窄的生活领域。生命意义研究表明，成功获得有意义的生活，往往伴随专注和范围的狭窄。

questions.passage: He gets assigned to a prison housing mostly those suspected of terrorism. He abuses these suspected terrorists, as in the infamous prison abuse case at Abu Ghraib. Mason thinks he is leading a meaningful life because he is making a difference in the world by protecting the American people. But is this a good life?
questions.prompt: Why does the passage end by asking whether Mason is leading a good life?
options: To test whether his work gives him a clear sense of personal purpose.
To distinguish felt meaning from a morally good life.
To compare his job's impact with that of other occupations.
To question whether he believes he can protect the American people.
questions.promptZh: 片段为什么以“Mason 这样算美好生活吗”结束？
optionsZh: 检验他的工作是否给他明确的个人目的感。
区分感到有意义与道德上美好的生活。
比较他的工作与其他职业造成的影响。
质疑他是否相信自己能保护美国人民。
analyses: A Mason 已自认为在保护人民、过着有意义的生活，末句的疑问转向这样的人生是否好，而不只是是否有个人目的感。
B 自认为有意义与虐待他人的行为形成冲突，说明主观意义不足以自动构成道德上美好的生活。Mason 是前文设置的假设人物，不能把这一情境当成真实人物的实证研究。
C 当前片段没有与其他职业比较影响大小，而是质疑行为的道德性质。
D Mason thinks ... by protecting the American people 已交代他的自我理解；作者质疑的是这种生活是否好，不是问他是否持有该信念。

evidence.quote: He abuses these suspected terrorists
Mason thinks he is leading a meaningful life
But is this a good life?

vocabulary.context: 修饰 terrorists，表明怀疑状态，不等于司法定罪
vocabulary.example: The suspected leak is still being investigated.

questions.translation: 他被派往一座主要关押涉嫌恐怖主义者的监狱。他虐待这些嫌疑人，就像臭名昭著的阿布格莱布监狱虐囚事件那样。Mason 认为自己在保护美国人民、给世界带来影响，因此过着有意义的生活。但这算美好生活吗？
